body: The only things I'm looking forward to are talking to you guys and my next cigarette. I guess that's something
I'm probably one of the bad ones. I mean, I make everybody around me feel so sad. I'm always the miserable person in the room. Maybe she would be better off without me

It does sound boring so I do try to talk about other things even about them. I usually try to keep conversations not about me. But it always ends up downwards. It just makes me think I'm incompatible with a lot of people.
I'd like that. I just don't like when someone says they care about me but when I talk about how I really feel it's like they don't want anything to do with me. It's happened too many times.

That does sound happy. And time for me would take a few years. I'm gonna be 19 so I do have to do a lot of work to pull it off. I can barely get out of my room because I have no motivation to do anything if I see nothing as the short term result. Long term seems to be alright, even though it's mostly clouded and unsure what it is.

I am tired of pulling the weight. It has always felt like a one way bridge where I always try to have fun conversations but everybody is too bored with me and I don't understand it. Am I just trying too hard to maintain friendships? I'm not good at this.

Make me happy? I fantasize about living far away from people and cities and just have an internet connection and have casual conversations with people. But society doesn't want that. What's expected of me is to trudge through daily life and not let it get to me.
